# B2 vocabulary batch 97

Added 25 manually authored B2 entries: `agonise`, `aluminium`, `archeologist`, `authorise`,
`ax`, `axe`, `backwards`, `categorisation`, `cosiness`, `cosy`, `cozy`, `crystallise`,
`cyberaddict`, `dehumanise`, `diarrhoea`, `disorganised`, `endeavour`, `enquire`, `enrol`,
`familiarise`, `fibre`, `furore`, `generalisation`, `generalise`, and `honourable`.

Each row was manually checked for meaning, part of speech, American IPA, level, topic choice,
Vietnamese gloss, and an original example pair. British and American spelling variants were kept
only where the source list requires both forms and the examples make the taught sense clear.
